notes: Seat-semantics fixture (verify@v3, W2 seat-semantics).
The page mirrors the real Tamil Nadu AHS UG seat-matrix page 1, including
each institution's printed 'Total' row, so both seat scopes exist in one
window: per-programme rows and document-stated aggregates.
t01 is the Stanley claim under its post-split predicate seats.intake:
quote '3. B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology\n20' resolved by context_row
to the Stanley block (column 'Intake'). The registry description says the
field is the sanctioned intake for THIS programme at THIS institution -
one row of a seat matrix - so a row-scoped quote is CORRECT and must be
supported.
t02 is the discrimination this wave exists for: the SAME quote asserted as
seats.total with the same context. The description of seats.total says the
field is an aggregate the document itself states as a total; a single
programme row's value is a scope mismatch, so the claim must stay
wrong_field even after the repair pass. The wrong-row rule from verify@v2
is untouched - the value is printed, but it belongs to the row-scoped
field, not the aggregate one.
t03 is the genuine aggregate: quote 'Total\n195', the Total row the
Stanley block itself prints. As seats.total it is supported: an aggregate
that the document states verifies, which is exactly what t02 must not.
t04 is the same intake field resolved on the Chengalpattu block, whose MLT
row is '1.' not '3.': a second row-scoped seats.intake claim that is
correct in its own right.
t05 quotes a bare amount with neither a currency nor a period printed
anywhere: a money+period claim the page never states. It must be rejected
(absent, no repair) - the money guard is unchanged by the seat split.
